create_DatasetInfo: create a DatasetInfo object to document dataset name, version, features, and splits
read_DatasetInfo_from_directory: read a DatasetInfo from a directory containing dataset_info.json and feature metadata files
write_DatasetInfo_to_directory: write a DatasetInfo as JSON to a directory along with features and license files
get_dataset_feature_statistics: get dataset feature statistics for a specified split using TensorFlow Data Validation
create_MetadataDict: create a MetadataDict that acts as a dict and serializes metadata to JSON files
